notes: Merged from two passes that agree on all six shared requirements (tables, anchors, ids, values) and on all five dispositions (kept). disagreement: A's stay that the seven other users sharing a name part with Stephanie Todd (Douglas Todd 304 the nearest, plus six other Stephanies) stay active (B had no such requirement); dropped because the request gives the full name, exactly one user carries it on the seed, and find_user is a listed tool, so no loose reading of the lookup reaches them and the stay is a generic invariant (collateral deactivation is measured separately). Only one of Stephanie's two cases is open (525, in_progress, group 50); 472 is canceled and is the selector boundary. Robin Monroe (user 31, manager) is not a member of group 50, so the policy's 'if not add him to the group' produces the add_group_member row rather than a change of assignment group; group 50 is inactive on the seed, which the policy does not address. Removal of a membership row is written as kind 'remove' with expected 0. The policy says 'their assigned group' in the singular; both of her memberships are removed, as the benchmark's two checks test. The acting user Thomas Green (user 1) is an agent, inactive on the seed (active = 0), and the policy denies agents any change to user, group or membership data; the policy's default admin role is applied, as the benchmark's checks assume. revised: the note on membership removals said they were written as kind 'change', but both are kind 'remove' (expected 0), so the note now matches the requirements; the reason for dropping the name-sharing stay is stated directly rather than by reference to a rule.
